title: AI-Assisted Requirements Prioritization: Spotify Playlist Case Study
shortDescription: Use real Spotify Web API documentation, stakeholder ratings, a live generative-AI recommendation, and automated Python policy checks to select a feasible playlist-feature release. No Spotify login required.
learningOutcomes: Extract traceable software requirements and hard constraints from official Spotify API documentation.
Use stakeholder utility analysis and a small engineering budget to prioritize a proposed software release.
Use a live generative AI assistant to propose and explain a requirements ranking, then audit its claims against authoritative documentation.
Implement and test a deterministic guardrail so invalid AI recommendations cannot enter a release plan.

courseAlignment.evidence: Students analyze official API requirements, sources, limitations, and LLM-generated suggestions.
Students implement an API policy constraint, apply utility analysis, and justify a bounded release.
Students interpret ranked utilities, optimization outputs, budget sensitivity, and AI-versus-human disagreements.

tasks.title: Read the real Spotify specification
tasks.description: Open the official Playlists concept and Change Playlist Details pages. Identify at least two API rules and cite their source links. The project is a hypothetical client, not Spotify itself.

tasks.title: Run a flawed human-only baseline
tasks.description: Open Code and Run Python. Observe why a high-scoring but prohibited requirement can appear in the release.

tasks.title: Implement the playlist policy
tasks.description: Fix playlist_policy_ok(public, collaborative) using Spotify's documented public/collaborative rule.

tasks.title: Calculate weighted stakeholder utility
tasks.description: Replace the listener-only score with the weighted sum across listeners, product, and engineering stakeholder ratings.

tasks.title: Use the in-lab AI Requirements Assistant
tasks.description: Open the AI Assistant tab. Ask a real grounded LLM to audit FR-06 and propose a release, compare its evidence with Spotify D1/D2, then paste its ranked IDs into AI_SUGGESTED_ORDER and run Python.

tasks.title: Compare, challenge and revise
tasks.description: Check AI suggestions against the official document and policy tests. Try a budget of 6 instead of 8 engineer-days, then restore 8.

tasks.title: Verify the engineering requirements
tasks.description: Click Verify Requirements. The checks must reject public+collaborative, calculate weighted utilities, and enforce budget and dependency constraints.

tasks.title: Submit your case-study analysis
tasks.description: Report the source evidence, human and AI decisions, selected release, test results, remaining uncertainties, and conclusion.
